entries.summary: Falls into endless repetition loops under greedy decoding — the card itself warns against it — and quantized builds hit it hardest at this size.

mitigations.note: Use the card's samplers (temp 0.6 / top_p 0.95 / top_k 20 thinking; 0.7 / 0.8 / 20 non-thinking); presence_penalty up to 1.5 if loops persist.
